threads.Author: claude
threads.Text: [Q] Judgment call to check: Phase 2 says losers get deleted the same day. Alternative is keeping shapes behind a config flag (like themes). I chose delete — three thread UIs is maintenance debt and the point of prototyping is deciding — but if you suspect you will want to switch shapes later, say so and Phase 2 keeps the cycle key.

threads.Author: claude
threads.Text: [B] Weakest estimate in the plan: Phase 1 assumes the v2 port is mechanical. The styleSet/theme layer and the wordwrap dependency are the two places most likely to fight the new API (lipgloss.Wrap replaces the old wrapping paths). If the spike blows past a day, the honest move is reporting back with the breakage list rather than pushing through — flagging so the expectation is set.
